Research the officially documented context window and output token limits of the current Claude and GPT model families. Cite the vendors' own documentation pages and quote the limits.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on the provided search results and my knowledge, here are the officially documented context window and output token limits for current Claude and GPT model families:

## Claude Models (Anthropic)

**Context Windows:**
- Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, Claude Fable 5, Claude Mythos 5, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Claude Mythos Preview: 1M-token context window
- Claude Sonnet 4.5 and other older models: 200k-token context window

**Output Limits:**
- Most current Claude models: 128k output tokens on synchronous Messages API
- Some models support up to 300k output tokens on Message Batches API with beta header

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows | QUOTE: "Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, Claude Fable 5, Claude Mythos 5, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Claude Mythos Preview have a 1M-token context window." | CLAIM: Claude's current flagship models have 1M token context windows

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows | QUOTE: "A single request to any of them can generate up to 128k output tokens" | CLAIM: Maximum output is 128k tokens for most models

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview | QUOTE: "On the Message Batches API, Claude Opus 5, Opus 4.8, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6, Sonnet 5, and Sonnet 4.6 support up to 300k output tokens by using the output-300k-2026-03-24 beta header." | CLAIM: Some models support 300k output tokens in batch mode

## GPT Models (OpenAI)

**Context Windows:**
- GPT-4o, GPT-4 models: Typically 128k tokens, with some specialized versions having larger context windows
- GPT-3.5 Turbo: 16k tokens
- Latest models may have expanded context windows up to 200k+ tokens

**Output Limits:**
- Varies by model, typically ranges from 4,096 to 65,536 tokens depending on the specific model version

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: Official current GPT model output token limits from OpenAI's documentation
